Additional vignettes

Source: vignettes/additional.Rmd
additional.Rmd

Due to size constraints, most vignettes are only available on the website for this package. The articles index lists all of them, including articles for each primary function (and its grouped_ variant), frequently asked questions, pairwise comparisons, interpretation of Bayes factors, and the design principles guiding the package:

https://www.indrapatil.com/ggstatsplot/articles/

Publication

A journal article describing the philosophy and principles behind this package: https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.03167

Presentation

Another quick way to get an overview of this package is to go through the following slides: https://www.indrapatil.com/intro-to-ggstatsplot/

Statistical backend of {ggstatsplot}

The statsExpressions package forms the statistical backend that processes data and creates data frames and expressions containing results from statistical tests.

For more exhaustive documentation for this package, including a summary of all supported statistical tests and effect sizes, see: https://www.indrapatil.com/statsExpressions/

Suggestions

If you find any bugs or have any suggestions/remarks, please file an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/ggstatsplot/issues
